meta: Concept site for Saltbreeze Home Cleaning, a made-up Tampa house cleaner: recurring, deep and move-out cleans with an instant price check. Designed by shash.builds.

hero.title: Come home to a clean house.
hero.sub: Weekly, every-other-week and one-time cleans across South Tampa and nearby. See your price in about a minute.
facts: Flat price, set before we start

services_title: Pick the clean that fits your week.
services: Weekly or every other week, with the same cleaner who knows how you like things.
Baseboards, grout, ceiling fans and the spots that build up over a busy month.
An empty-home clean for renters, buyers, sellers and landlords.
Fresh linens, a stocked kitchen and a full reset between guests.
Fine dust and debris cleanup once the contractors pack up.
Inside the fridge, inside the oven, interior windows and a load of laundry.

estimator.title: See your price before you book.
estimator.note: Sample prices for this concept. On a live site, the owner sets these numbers.

steps_title: Booked in a minute. Clean by Friday.
steps: Pick your rooms and how often. The price you see is the price you pay.
Morning or afternoon, any weekday. We text to confirm.
Your cleaner texts when they're on the way and sends a checklist when they're done.

hero.alt: A bright, spotless white kitchen with a long island, pendant lights and a dining table by the windows.

g1.alt: A tidy white living room with a sofa, armchair, glass coffee table and a patterned rug.

g2.alt: A clean U-shaped kitchen with wiped counters, a steel sink and potted flowers on the windowsill.

area.title: South Tampa and the neighborhoods around it.
area.note: If your ZIP isn't listed, ask. We add new streets as our team grows.

about.title: Small team, same faces.
body: Most cleaning companies send whoever is free that day. You end up explaining the same things every visit.
We keep one cleaner on each home. They learn where the dog hides, which counters are marble and which room to skip when someone's working from home.

promise.title: Missed a spot? We come back within 24 hours.
promise.body: Tell us within a day of your clean and we'll send someone back to fix it, free. No forms, just a text.

faq: Do I need to be home?
No. Most clients give us a door code or a key. Your cleaner texts when they arrive and when they leave.
Yes, everything, including the vacuum. If you'd like us to use your own products, leave them out and we will.
Yes. Tell us their names and any rooms they should stay out of.
By card after each clean. You're never charged before the work is done.
What if I need to skip or move a clean?
Text us 24 hours ahead and we'll move it at no charge.

form.title: Tell us about your home.
form.note: We text back within the hour during business hours with your price and the next open times.
